# Decisions that shaped the result

<!-- generated by `ggh writeup` from the results bundle and committed evidence; edit DECISIONS in src/ggh/release/writeup.py, not this file -->

The project recorded every decision in [docs/decisions.md](../decisions.md) (`OWNER` marks a ruling the owner made). These are the ones that most shaped what was built and what the numbers mean, one line each. What the project is for: the [one-page PRD summary](prd-one-page.md) and the full [PRD](../../Gemma%20Grounded%20Health%20PRD.md).

- **D-2** (2026-11-15): Train on EvalKit's own PubMedQA prompt, so the benchmark measures grounding, not a new format.
- **D-3** (2026-11-15): Answer targets are the author's conclusion, filtered sentence by sentence for support, with advice removed.
- **D-4** (2026-11-15): Choose checkpoints on the dev split only; the expert set never chooses anything.
- **D-5** (2026-11-15): Score the shipped artifact: the quantised GGUF served by llama-server, for base and fine-tune alike.
- **D-11** (2026-11-15): Build with the lean Kova harness "exactly as EvalKit was": graph, catalog, gates, skeptical verifier.
- **OWNER D-15** (2026-11-15): Teach "maybe" with context-ablation examples, since the training set has only yes and no.
- **OWNER D-17** (2026-11-15): Evaluate on every expert-labelled question, not a sample.
- **D-20** (2026-11-15): Every number in the card, README and project page is generated from the results bundle.
- **D-41** (2026-11-17): Run llama-server with the reasoning budget at zero, after the fine-tune opened a hidden thinking channel.
- **OWNER D-43** (2026-11-17): After v1 cited aim sentences, build a v2, labelled as built after v1's test results were seen.
- **OWNER D-48** (2026-11-18): Choose citations by per-sentence support, ranked by entailment rather than word overlap.
- **OWNER D-50** (2026-11-18): Train v2 although its third target audit missed the bar by a small margin, and disclose the miss.
- **OWNER D-55** (2026-11-19): Release v2 with its dev headline, label-accuracy and parity misses disclosed, not tuned away.
- **OWNER D-57** (2026-11-19): Run the v2 benchmark on OpenAI only after the Anthropic credit ran out ("Use Open AI API").
- **OWNER D-60** (2026-11-19): Calibration labels come from Claude Opus 5.5 under a committed prompt, and every report says so.
- **OWNER D-61** (2026-11-20): The off-scope and sample reviews are blind Claude Opus 5.5 reviews ("Model reviews both").
- **OWNER D-62** (2026-11-20): Keep the pre-registered numbers, disclose the aim rule, and drop any v2-over-base citation claim.
- **OWNER D-63** (2026-11-20): The demo is the local app against the benchmarked GGUF, not a paid ZeroGPU Space.
